title: Godzilla Minus Zero and The Military Industrial Complex

commenti.body: Interesting review. You seem to praise the movie for the same elements that you also criticize it for, almost like you are conflicted in even liking the movie or wanting to offer a blanket criticism to offset your supposed enjoyment. When you approach a movie to review it or share your thoughts, do you feel like you are more interested in the things you liked about it or the things you disliked?

>Def prefer to talk about things I liked, all my other stuff is basically just going over how movies and shows do things well. When you talk about things you dislike, it could be just as easy that I didn't understand it or wasn't in the right mood for it. I gave the holy mountain 5 stars but that could be 2 stars on another day.However when I talk about things I like I can be 100% sure about it because well...i liked it. I suppose there are times when you go back and dislike something you previously liked. I did that with ex machina. But for the most part it seems to be much rarer for me.And ya this review is a bit all over the place, def just an exercise to relax a bit when it comes to editing. In my other stuff I would legit agonize over single frames for large amounts of time. This helped to see where I can loosen up a bit but plan on going back to more meticulous ideas.
